messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's action to standing in a thoughtful pose, following the movement shown in the motion reference video. Retain the current person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, and expression. Leave the scene and camera unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the person's action to standing in a thoughtful pose, as demonstrated in the reference video. Follow the movement shown in the reference video while retaining the current person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, and expression. Leave the scene and camera unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"He stands on the road, raises a phone to his ear, turns his body, and lowers the phone by the end.","camera":"Low-angle full-body shot from the side, with the camera remaining mostly static.","clothing":"Light plaid button-up shirt with rolled sleeves, brown suspenders, dark gray jeans, and dark shoes.","hair_color":"Dark brown to black.","hairstyle":"Short dark hair pulled back into a small topknot at the crown.","identity":"A slim adult man with a short beard and dark hair tied back in a small topknot.","scene":"An outdoor paved road beneath a concrete overpass, with guardrails, red-and-yellow striped posts, a parked white truck, and a construction crane in the background under a partly cloudy sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The man now performs a thoughtful sequence: he raises a hand to his chin/neck, turns his body, crosses his arms, and then lowers his arms to return to a standing pose. The same character, clothing, road/overpass scene, and low-angle static camera are retained.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's action to a thoughtful standing pose following the reference motion, while preserving identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, scene, and camera.
uncertain: Whether the facial expression was fully preserved throughout the new motion.
unexpected_changes: A phone-like object appears in the hand during the pose, although the reference motion did not clearly show a phone.
